why: On 30 July 2024, after extreme rain, debris flows tore down the Mundakkai and Chooralmala valleys. The same forest that machines clear in straight lines was stripped here along a winding river path: the shape of the scar is the evidence.
title: Wayanad landslide — Wayanad, Kerala, India (2024-02-05 → 2024-12-16)
pixel_note: Sentinel-2 L2A, resampled to 512 px over the box
story: On 30 July 2024, after extreme rain, debris flows tore down the Mundakkai and Chooralmala valleys. The same forest that machines clear in straight lines was stripped here along a winding river path: the shape of the scar is the evidence.
look_for: Region 1, the debris path down the valley, reads strongly natural: an irregular, fingered outline
Its change signal is far above the image's own noise, so the change is certainly real
